Manhattan.","source_id":"SYNTHESIZED_OPENER","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"When you're ready, head for Strawberry Fields — about a 10-minute walk straight center.","source_id":"GLUE_STAGING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"This is the memorial to John Lennon — a 2.5-acre garden shaped like a teardrop, right across the street from the Dakota, where he lived with Yoko Ono when he was murdered in 1980.","source_id":"072cf20e-f887-4217-a4b0-216d87bbe13d","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"When the city rebuilt this ground, Ono asked for something unusual: a living memorial, not a statue.","source_id":"dd2995d3-2984-45f4-8ec6-5540f39e6023","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"She thought there were already enough statues in Central Park — that's how the parks landscape architect, Arne Abramowitz, remembered it.","source_id":"dd2995d3-2984-45f4-8ec6-5540f39e6023","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"The land had taken his name back in April 1981.","source_id":"dd2995d3-2984-45f4-8ec6-5540f39e6023","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"But at the time it sat marooned on a traffic median, boxed in by a park road and two slip roads, so that August the city announced a full rebuild.","source_id":"dd2995d3-2984-45f4-8ec6-5540f39e6023","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"The design came from Bruce Kelly, chief landscape architect for the Central Park Conservancy.","source_id":"5d0b69cd-9280-4c3b-8198-e4e4dee38164","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Construction began in April 1984.","source_id":"5d0b69cd-9280-4c3b-8198-e4e4dee38164","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"It opened on October 9, 1985 — what would have been Lennon's 45th birthday.","source_id":"5d0b69cd-9280-4c3b-8198-e4e4dee38164","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Ono led the dedication alongside mayor Ed Koch, and her son Sean stood with them, celebrating his own tenth birthday that same day.","source_id":"5d0b69cd-9280-4c3b-8198-e4e4dee38164","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Speaking for the United Nations was Marcela Pérez de Cuéllar, its first lady.","source_id":"5d0b69cd-9280-4c3b-8198-e4e4dee38164","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"The couple loved this quiet corner of the park, and every year fans still gather on his birthday, October 9, and the night he died, December 8, singing his favorite songs late into the dark.","source_id":"072cf20e-f887-4217-a4b0-216d87bbe13d","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"A bronze plaque nearby lists the 121 countries that donated trees, plants, and stones to bless the site as a garden of peace.","source_id":"072cf20e-f887-4217-a4b0-216d87bbe13d","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"That's Strawberry Fields — a living garden where a statue might have
